text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a clear blue day, I decide to have
lunch on the roof... But when I
go up, I see
that someone's beaten me there.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... Sure! Oh good, it sounds like
everyone's doing well.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Me? Yeah, I'm getting along fine... Oh,
you heard about the tryout
race?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Uh, yeah, about that... You see, I haven't
found a trainer yet. Right,
so my debut's
gonna have to stay on hold—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it's not that they're not good
enough! They're just... you know,
missing
something.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh... Mhm, thanks. I know you're all
rooting for me, so I won't let
you down!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right then... Okay, talk to you later.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Pheeeeew...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wah! Oh, it's you...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wah! Oh, it's you...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, were you planning on having lunch
here? Sorry for taking up
the place.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You sure know how to pick a spot. Eating
up here in this lovely
weather's a
wonderful idea.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You sure know how to pick a spot. Eating
up here in this lovely
weather's a
wonderful idea.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It would be really refreshing... Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, the call just now?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, not at all! Those were my cute
little juniors back home. I enjoy
talking to
them all the time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We've kept in touch since I switched
schools and came to Tracen.
They're good
kids.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Honestly,
if they hadn't talked me into it,
I'd never have considered
coming to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is it that unbelievable? Well, it's
true.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned it before, but I only run
because of how much fun I
have doing it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned it before, but I only run
because of how much fun I
have doing it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But before I knew it, everyone was looking
up to me... They told me
they want to see
me out there winning.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm like their big sis—
how could I let them
down?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, that's all there is to it, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Maruzensky! Hey, Maruzenskyyy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Heeey! Off to do some training? Keep
it up!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thaaanks! I'm gonna put everything you
taught me to good use! See
you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Have fuuun! And stay safe out there!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, isn't she cute?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm really grateful. They're all such nice
kids.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And that one—she has a terribly shy little
sister who was so scared to
go out, she'd
just stay cooped up in her room.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But they went and saw the Twinkle Series
together and had loads of
fun. Now she's
not scared to go out at all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The older one wants to keep showing her
sister more amazing things,
so that's why
she's trying so hard here at school.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Isn't it?! I think it's just fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Like a dazzling dream even.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's your dream? I really wanna
know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's your dream? I really wanna
know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For a training specialist at the famous
Tracen Academy, I bet yours is to train a
G1 racer, right? Or maybe you have more
worldly
ambitions?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
That's what every trainer wants,
right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The trainers here especially are all
excellent. They're really driven to
succeed.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I... wish I had the same energy to match
it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, look at you. You really are strange,
just like I thought.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, look at you. You really are strange,
just like I thought.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Listen for a sec. At this very moment, on
this roof, there's a trainer
and a racer, both
of whom are free.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Listen for a sec. At this very moment, on
this roof, there's a trainer
and a racer, both
of whom are free.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And you like my running so much that I
catch you watching me
whenever you can.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And you like my running so much that I
catch you watching me
whenever you can.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My heart's dancing,
'cause I've finally met
a trainer who isn't all gung
ho about
winning the biggest prize.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, in light of our present
circumstances...
is there anything special
you'd like to ask
me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, in light of our present
circumstances...
is there anything special
you'd like to ask
me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, good, you know how to take a
hint! And you nailed it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, good, you know how to take a
hint! And you nailed it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. I'd love to have you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working together,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working together,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I've become Maruzensky's trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Now that we're formally
partners, can I ask you a
favor real quick?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The little ones said that calling is fine
and
all, but they'd rather use
something called
a "chat app."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I can't figure it out. Is that something
different from texting?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the first thing I get to work on is...
explaining what a chat app is.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, so those things are called "apps"...
Phones these days are so
complicated.
